_comment: TEMPLATE. Copy to profile.json (git-ignored) and edit for your own search. Delete any field to disable that filter. CLI flags override these per run.
_titles_hint: keep a posting if its TITLE contains ANY of these
title: software engineer
software developer
full stack
backend
frontend
_stack_hint: keep if the title/description contains ANY of these (whole-word: 'java' won't match 'javascript')
_level_hint: keep only if the TITLE contains ANY of these; delete this field to include all levels
_exclude_hint: drop if the TITLE contains ANY of these
_locations_hint: remote: 'us' | 'any' | 'none'. Each zone: match a city -> allow only those modes. Omit 'locations' to accept all locations/modes.
